title: Liquid Orbit
description: A breathing liquid form refracts real product screens, surrounded by selectable orbiting work.
signature: Three smooth-union volumes breathe as one gel form; public screens refract through the surface while project images orbit around it.
holdback: The source confirms genuine ray-marched refraction matching the visibly distorted image, and selecting a thumbnail changes the displayed project. That real optical technique does not make the concept specific: the orb distorts the reading interface while the useful previews remain tiny. Removing it leaves the project selectors, description, and Explore project link intact. Both captures emphasize the treatment over understanding the work.
slopCauses: A liquid blob has no demonstrated relationship to the owner's work.
Oversized identity with the checklist's trailing full stop.
